resolutions.researcher_notes: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2013, Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2012', p.79, Saudi Arabia section lists the row 'AY–1 KP 943/Riyadh | Saudi Aramco | 95 (miles) | 48 (inches)'. Being tabulated in OPEC's roster of existing gas pipelines carrying gas confirms 'operating' by context (status is inferred, not a literal token in the table). Direct opec.org flipbook 403s for this UA; verified via Wayback snapshot which reproduces the full table (943 present + row read). Single source-origin (OPEC), so medium.

The AY–1 KP 943/Riyadh row appears in OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 titled 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members' — the row is inside the natural-gas-pipeline table, confirming Fuel = Gas. Verified via Wayback snapshot of opec.org page 79.

OPEC ASB2013 p.79 lists the AY–1 KP 943/Riyadh line length as 95 miles (Length column header is '(miles)'). 95 miles = 152.9 km, which the GEM value of 153.00 km matches exactly on conversion. Confirms LengthKnown=153 km. Single OPEC origin, so medium.
OPEC ASB2013 p.79 lists the AY–1 KP 943/Riyadh line diameter as 48 inches (Diameter column header '(inches)'), matching GEM Diameter=48.00 in. Single OPEC origin, so medium.

OPEC ASB2013 p.79 lists the row under the 'Saudi Arabia' country heading (StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea = Saudi Arabia) with route 'AY–1 KP 943/Riyadh' — Riyadh is the terminal endpoint (StartState/Province=Riyadh). Confirms Saudi Arabia + Riyadh. Precise city coordinates/point locations not in the table; endpoint names only.
OPEC ASB2013 p.79 'Owner or operator' column for the AY–1 KP 943/Riyadh row reads 'Saudi Aramco', matching Owner1=Saudi Aramco (100%). Single OPEC origin, so medium.
